en_US.title: Pressure Job Title Table
en_US.scanner: Job titles should explain what kept the colony alive.
en_US.field_note: Every title should imply a tool, route or failure.
en_US.terminal: JOB TITLES: pump tech, seal rigger, route clerk, brine diver, fabricator operator, medlock aide, relay custodian, vent kiln hand, Atlas safety reader and shift supervisor.
en_US.audio: Nobody died as Employee 438. They died doing a job.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The job title table turns worker evidence into mechanics: pump rooms, medlocks, routes, kilns and Atlas safety consoles.
en_US.external_site: Pressure job titles give the colony a stable labor vocabulary: pump chief, brine cartographer, vent-forge operator, relay notary, and the roles that make evidence physical.

en_US.title: Locker Prop Variants
en_US.scanner: A locker should say what a worker touched before the flood.
en_US.field_note: Avoid sentimental clutter. Use work marks.
en_US.terminal: LOCKER VARIANTS: pressure tape, worn gasket, tool crib token, meal-credit strip, shift sticker, route chalk, medlock denial slip, and Marauder correction note.
en_US.audio: The best memorial is a tool still dirty from the last shift.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Locker variants let procedural placement carry human texture without custom cutscenes.
en_US.external_site: Locker Prop Variants defines reusable art and wiki hooks for colony evidence.

ru_RU.title: Варианты предметов шкафчика
ru_RU.scanner: Шкафчик должен говорить, к чему рабочий прикасался до flood.
ru_RU.field_note: Избегать сентиментального хлама. Использовать следы работы.
ru_RU.terminal: LOCKER VARIANTS: pressure tape, worn gasket, tool crib token, meal-credit strip, shift sticker, route chalk, medlock denial slip и Marauder correction note.
ru_RU.audio: Лучший мемориал - инструмент, еще грязный с последней смены.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Варианты шкафчика позволяют procedural placement нести человеческую фактуру без custom cutscenes.
